ينأطر (form VII)
# يَنْأَطِرُ (yanʔaṭiru) /jan.ʔa.tˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# يَنْأَطِرَ (yanʔaṭira) /jan.ʔa.tˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# يَنْأَطِرْ (yanʔaṭir) /jan.ʔa.tˤir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
